name: Stone Palm
description: Strike with the open palm while earth qi hardens the hand like stone and drives the blow into the chest.

name: Packed Guard
description: Pack earth qi along both forearms and take a blow on them without giving ground.

name: Soil Settle
description: Press the sole into the ground and step forward onto footing that does not slide or give.

name: Loamfist
description: Throw a fist heavy with earth qi so the blow lands with the weight of packed soil behind it.

name: Root Stance
description: Sink the weight and send qi down through the heels so the body steadies and the next strikes land heavier.

name: Boulder Shoulder
description: Turn the hardened shoulder into the opponent's chest and shove with the whole standing frame.

name: Earthen Jab
description: Snap a short straight punch with a fist packed with qi so the knuckles land like a thrown stone.

name: Clod Hammer
description: Bring both joined fists down on the target in one chop weighted with earth qi.

name: Dense Forearm
description: Harden the outer forearm and sweep a punch or kick wide so its force passes the body.

name: Packed Knuckle
description: Focus earth qi into the lead knuckle and drive it at one point on the chest or ribs.

name: Shale Elbow
description: Drive the elbow across at close range with qi layered along the bone like flaking rock.

name: Bedrock Block
description: Plant both feet and cross the arms so earth qi spreads through the frame and holds against a heavy blow.

name: Cobble Hook
description: Swing a looping fist from the hip with earth qi packed in the knuckles to hit the jaw or flank.

name: Sole Listen
description: Press both soles to the ground and feel through the earth for the steps of anyone moving nearby.

name: Tremor Read
description: Tap the ground once and read the small shiver that returns to find hollows or buried stone.

name: Heft Reading
description: Feel how deeply a stranger's weight presses the ground and judge how heavy and how armed they are.

name: Footfall Tally
description: Count the separate footfalls arriving through the earth to learn how many walk toward you.

name: Dull Step
description: Bleed the force of each step into the earth so the foot lands without a sound or shiver.

name: Clay Grip
description: Soften the earth under the target's hand into clay that closes round the wrist and holds it.

name: Mire Clutch
description: Turn the ground at the target's feet to thick mire that sucks at the ankles and slows each step.

name: Clinging Mud
description: Keep a skin of wet clay wrapped round a foe's leg and tighten it each time the foe pulls.

name: Clay Palm
description: Slap the target with a palm coated in dense clay that adds weight and leaves the skin smeared and numb.

name: Slick Clay
description: Spread a film of greasy clay under the opponent's lead foot so the charge ends in a slip.

name: Silt Pull
description: Draw fine silt up around the target's calves and tug them off their line.

name: Clay Shell
description: Wrap the forearm and fist in a thick shell of clay that absorbs cuts and blunt blows alike.

name: Kneaded Clay
description: Shove a heavy lump of kneaded clay into the opponent's chest and lean the weight through it.

name: Pebble Flick
description: Snap a small pebble off the thumb with a pulse of qi so it hits the face like a sling shot.

name: Cast Stone
description: Hurl a fist-sized stone straight at the target with the whole arm and a surge of earth qi.

name: Flint Throw
description: Throw a sharp flake of flint charged with qi so the edge cuts as it strikes.

name: Arcing Stone
description: Lob a stone in a high curve so it drops onto a target behind cover or a raised guard.

name: Stone Catch
description: Pull a thrown stone out of the air with a hardened open hand and turn it aside.

name: Rock Hoist
description: Lift loose stones off the ground to hand height with qi and hold them ready to be thrown.

name: Ballast Step
description: Take a short heavy step that sinks the front foot and keeps the whole body stable behind it.

name: Rooted Pivot
description: Turn on the planted heel with qi gripping the earth so the body swings round without drifting.

name: Anchor Heel
description: Dig the rear heel in and brace so a hard shove cannot push the body back a pace.

name: Grinding Advance
description: Press forward in small flat steps with earth qi under each foot so no shove can unseat the advance.

name: Stride Press
description: Close the distance in one long stride and drive the palm out as the rear foot lands.

name: Earth Shift
description: Slide sideways on a patch of ground that firms behind the foot and slips under it in front.

name: Plant Stance
description: Set a wide low stance and feed qi into the legs so the strikes that follow carry more of the body.

name: Gravel Toss
description: Fling a handful of gravel charged with qi so it spreads across the front and stings every face.

name: Pebble Spray
description: Sweep the hand low and send a fan of pebbles skittering at the legs of a group.

name: Grit Burst
description: Clap the hands on a fistful of grit to burst it outward in a stinging cloud of sharp flecks.

name: Cobble Volley
description: Throw three small cobbles in quick succession at the same target before it can adjust.

name: Shingle Sweep
description: Kick up a wave of flat loose stones along the ground so they rattle against the shins of those ahead.

name: Stone Skin
description: Draw earth qi into the skin until it turns blows like rock and holds as long as the breath is steady.

name: Shell Shoulder
description: Roll the hardened shoulder into an incoming strike so it glances off the curve of the body.

name: Bone Weight
description: Pack earth qi into the long bones so every limb swings heavier and is harder to knock aside.

name: Hide Plate
description: Thicken a patch of skin over the ribs into a plate that stops a blade point or a hard kick.

name: Marble Forearm
description: Smooth and harden the forearm until a weapon slides along it and away from the body.

name: Flint Palm
description: Harden the heel of the palm to a flinty edge and chop at the collarbone or neck.

name: Dense Breath
description: Breathe slowly and let the earth qi settle into the chest so the ribs shrug off the next blow.

name: Slate Hide
description: Layer qi under the skin like split slate so a glancing cut slides off and a hard cut still bites shallow.

name: Slab Rise
description: Lift a flat slab of earth upright in front of the body to stop a charge or a thrown stone.

name: Earth Lift
description: Raise the ground under the opponent's foot a hand's breadth to break the stride.

name: Slab Shove
description: Push a rising slab of earth into the opponent's body so it knocks them back a pace.

name: Flagstone
description: Tilt a flat paving of stone up from the ground as a quick shield against a low strike.

name: Rising Lip
description: Raise a low lip of earth across the opponent's path so a running foe trips over it.

name: Plate Press
description: Slam a thin plate of hardened earth against the target with both palms and lean through it.

name: Heel Stamp
description: Drive the heel down so a short tremor runs under the opponent's feet and shakes their balance.

name: Foot Quake
description: Send a thin line of shaking along the ground to the target and break the plant of the lead foot.

name: Quiver Stamp
description: Stamp twice in a quick pair so the ground quivers and makes a drawn weapon waver.

name: Rumble Ring
description: Stamp and let a ring of shaking spread outward to jolt everyone standing close to the user.

name: Settling Thud
description: Drop the full weight onto the heels so a dull thud jars the ankles of those nearby.

name: Stagger Tremor
description: Keep a low steady shaking running under the target so each attempt to plant a foot fails.

name: Deep Thump
description: Slam the palm flat on the ground and send a single heavy pulse that throws loose footing aside.
